text:
Alyssa: Quick sync for Nimbus Health POC. They need streaming SDK demo (Python), function/tool-calls that emit structured JSON, SAML SSO, KMS for PHI, and a reserved capacity estimate. Who can take lead on SDK+perf?
Tom H: Ill own SDK integration and perf harness. Will produce Python samples + curl fallback.
Priya S: I'll handle the security questionnaire (encryption, key separation, SOC2/DPA). Need an annotated KMS flow doc to show to Legal.
Kevin L: For SSO we have the SP config template. @Alyssa please upload IdP metadata. On capacity: customer expects steady ~50 rps streaming, spikes to ~200. Target p50 <200ms.
Alyssa: Uploaded IdP XML and initial security answers to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood.com/nimbus/poc (folder: security).
PresalesBot: Created POC ticket POC-3851. Owners: Alyssa, Tom H. Due: 2026-04-08.
Tom H: Short Python streaming example for their engineers (will add schema validation step in harness):
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="REDACTED")
with client.streaming.generate(model="rw-small-quant", stream=True) as s:
    s.call_tool("entity_extractor", {"text": payload})
    for ev in s:
        # ev.text should be a JSON string that matches contract
        print(ev.text)
```
Priya S: Also request: signed DPA + SOC2 report + pen test summary. I'll attach our SOC2 and the KMS diagram.
Kevin L: I'll sketch a provisional dedicated commit: ~2k GPU-hours/month baseline. Will refine after Tom posts perf numbers. Also drafting fallback policy: dedicated -> canary autoscale -> hosted small model.
Alyssa: Acceptance criteria to confirm with Nimbus: 1) streaming demo with tool-call producing validated JSON; 2) perf p50 <200ms at sustained 50 rps; 3) SAML SSO end-to-end tested; 4) contract: DPA signed + SOC2 available. Proposed demo next Tue 10am PT.
Tom H: Running perf now on rw-small-quant with 2x batcher. I'll upload results in ~30m.
Alyssa: Thanks. Please keep updates in this thread and drop final perf + pricing into the drive so I can loop Legal and CS. :thumbsup:
